name: MKX - Nano Nectar Syrup 200mg - Strawberry
description: Our Nano emulsified syrup is the perfect add-in to your favorite beverage! You can use it in hot or cold beverages, and even as a food topping! Infused with Nano-THC which means you feel effects in 15 minutes or less. Mix any of our flavors into your drink and experience a high you’ll never forget.
